I would also note, however, that even if Strick land were deemed to require an objection to any jury instruction that failed to follow MUJL, Hutchings' counsel still could not properly be found deficient. The MUJI amendment cited by the majority was adopted at least several months after Hutchings was convicted (on September 4, 2007). (The MUJI instructions do not seem to carry an adoption date, but the archive.org "way-back machine" confirms that the new instruction cited by the majority was not available on the MUJI website as of December 15, 2007, but was available by February 13, 2008.
